# ui::ImageDecodeOptions

Header: `winui/render/Bitmap.hpp`.

What [Bitmap::decode()](bitmap.md#decode)/read() should do beyond decoding.

Example: 
```cpp
// A 256px thumbnail of a camera photo, upright.
const ui::Bitmap thumb = ui::Bitmap::read("IMG_0042.jpg", {.max_width = 256, .max_height = 256});
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `max_width` | `int` | `0` | The largest the result may be, aspect ratio kept; zero leaves that axis unconstrained. A picture already inside the bounds is never enlarged. The bounds apply to the upright picture, so a portrait photo stored sideways fits the same box as one stored upright. |
| `max_height` | `int` | `0` | See `max_width`. |
| `apply_orientation` | `bool` | `true` | Turn the pixels upright per the file's EXIF orientation. |
